actions.action: Notes the talk of a driver knocked down on the rank in his notebook and means to ask on the rank for the man.
Writes the protection demand on the caff into the red book without comment.
Calls at the caff and asks Grace Rinaldi whether she wishes to make a statement; she says not yet.
Walks to Mickey's office and tells Frank to his face that she pays nobody ten a week.

goals.philip_danby: Keep walking the quay and notice who looks frightened, then tell nobody.
goals.jason_pinder: Stay out of Frank's way and get through the week without anyone linking him to the caff window.
goals.rita_welburn: Take in what Darren Milner is selling and price each piece.
goals.dougie_saltmarsh: Pay Keith Garbutt for a read of Frank and tell the Widow only what is worth it.
goals.ada_vane: Watch Mickey's from her window and ring the night desk if anything happens in the street.
goals.terry_hodgson: Do his nights, say nothing, and watch whether Frank stays steady.
goals.darren_milner: Find some of the twenty-two pounds, or enough news to sell, before Frank calls again.
goals.grace_rinaldi: Refuse Frank's ten a week, mend the window and keep a note of every man who comes in.
goals.shane_boddy: Keep Jason talking and quiet at once, and shift some more metal.
goals.pc_ibbotson: Find the man hit on the rank and get a statement.
goals.sheila_dunn: Size up Frank on the books and in the red book, and say nothing to anyone.
goals.brendan_walsh: Visit Ada and anyone who has stopped coming to chapel, and listen.
goals.june_suddaby: Finish sorting her father's things and decide whether she can stay.
goals.keith_garbutt: Sell the true reads to whoever pays, and make nobody his enemy.
goals.kevin_needham: Get Frank to ask him what the drivers think, and keep his fares up.
goals.albert_suggitt: Mend the nets and tell Ada what the quay is saying.
goals.lily_tang: Keep the orders steady and remember who does not turn up.
goals.peter_tang: Keep honest trade and keep out of whatever is brewing on the parade.
goals.shaun_hewson: Finish the parade boards and enjoy telling people what he saw from the ladder.
goals.sylvia_rennison: Get the rent from the lodger three weeks behind and keep house rules.
